findings.title: Remote/RSS HTML stored and rendered raw without sanitization (stored XSS)
findings.body: Imported content is saved with cook_method raw_html. Post#cook then returns raw unchanged, so this HTML is never sanitized. The embed view and normal topic views output it with `raw post.cooked`. Any script or event-handler attributes in the feed or fetched page run on the forum origin. Readability only partially filters the import_remote path, and the RSS path in poll_feed is not filtered at all.

findings.title: URL interpolated unescaped into HTML attribute
findings.body: The embed URL is inserted unescaped into `<a href='#{url}'>`. A URL containing a single quote can break out of the attribute and inject markup. That markup is then rendered raw because of the raw_html cook method.

findings.title: Mutates caller's string in place
findings.body: `contents <<` appends to the string the caller passed in. If that string is frozen (for example a literal under frozen_string_literal), this raises an error. Otherwise it silently modifies the caller's object.

findings.title: Embed URL host not validated before enqueueing; spec expects synchronous retriever
findings.body: The controller only checks the referer, then enqueues a job for any embed_url, so any visitor can trigger repeated job enqueues. The spec expects `TopicRetriever.new` and `retrieve` to be called directly from the controller. Because the controller enqueues a job instead, that test will fail when jobs are queued.

findings.title: Every uncached embed request triggers a full feed poll
findings.body: Each embed URL that is missing from the database runs a full PollFeed synchronously. That fetches the feed and reimports every item. A new topic is created for each embed URL, and the throttle is keyed on the URL, so an attacker can force repeated full feed fetches by sending distinct URLs.

findings.title: Referer injected into script without JS escaping
findings.body: `request.referer` is written into a JS string literal with only HTML escaping. That does not reliably prevent breaking out of the string. Passing the full referer URL as targetOrigin is also fragile.

findings.title: Nil content crash
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` raises NoMethodError when a feed item has no content element, which is common in RSS feeds that only provide a description. The exception aborts the whole poll, so remaining items are not imported.

findings.title: `end if` is a syntax/logic error
findings.body: `<%- end if %>` combines `end` with a dangling `if` modifier whose condition is whatever ERB code follows. It is likely a parse error or, at best, unintended behavior; it should be a plain `end`.
